title: Module:Mount/skills
text: -- Effects of the mount skills, shown when you hover over a skill name. -- One line per skill. The key must be the skill name exactly as it appears in the item description. -- Use \n for a line break inside the text. -- Several mounts share the same skills, so each skill only needs to be written once. -- -- Example of the format (replace with the real in-game text): -- ["Run!"] = "Effect text here.", -- ["Wild Charge"] = { effect = "Effect text here.\nSecond line." }, return { }
html:
-- Effects of the mount skills, shown when you hover over a skill name.
-- One line per skill. The key must be the skill name exactly as it appears in the item description.
-- Use \n for a line break inside the text.
-- Several mounts share the same skills, so each skill only needs to be written once.
--
-- Example of the format (replace with the real in-game text):
--   ["Run!"] = "Effect text here.",
--   ["Wild Charge"] = { effect = "Effect text here.\nSecond line." },
